purpose: Shared development workflows for restoring and operating the project on a new development machine.

workflows.typecheckAll: npm run types && npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
workflows.integrationTests: npm run types && npx vitest run --config tests/vitest.config.ts
workflows.allTests: node --test tests/unit/*.test.js && npm run types && npx vitest run --config tests/vitest.config.ts
workflows.migrateLocalDatabase: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply ithaca-journal-local --local
workflows.migrateStagingDatabase: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply ithaca-journal-staging --remote --env staging
workflows.migrateProductionDatabase: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply ithaca-journal-production --remote --env production
workflows.deployStaging: node ./scripts/validate-access-config.mjs staging && npx wrangler deploy --env staging
workflows.deployProduction: node ./scripts/validate-access-config.mjs production && npx wrangler deploy --env production
